reviews.review_msg: Very kind person but an inadequate professor. A lack of communication about assignments and expectations led to much frustration. Often felt unsupported due to ambiguous answers to questions or late responses to emails. What helped was building friendships in the class, so if you were to take it, your peers are who will help you, not the professor.
Robert is kind and caring, although he lacks communication, and his classes seem to be all over the place. This class is v different than other classes and he is very supportive.

Dr. Williamson uses the UDL method while teaching. For the assignment that took up most of our final grade, we were able to resubmit it based on feedback. He was also very accessible outside of class hours.

The prof's organization of the course is an issue. Examples: he used outdated assignment rubrics from past years & didn't update them. He didn't give a course breakdown (violation of sfu policy) He wasn't organized, didn't reply to student emails &didn't support us in tutoring. The class stopped asking for help from him we didn't feel comfortable
